allow.why: STYLED_KINDS is the theme schema's own list of the kinds a theme holds presets for, written out so the theme's type has their names; a test holds it to the kinds' themeStyle.

A shader the file declares with transition() is marked as a transition's, by that name, and a file uses shaders when an effect or a transition names one. The kind table cannot be asked here: it loads after this file.

The layout check measures the drawn page, where captions are told by the kind on their cell: it checks other elements against their lines, starts their box from the lower safe area and words their fix. To move into render/src/elements/captions with entries for those three.
The table of props that are not drawn as written names the element each is on; the lint reads it.
